title: Waste$$$Cupholder
text:
Waste$$$Cupholder. Holder itself is flimsy, hangdown portion of holder for the fold-down tray is a joke.
BUT THE VELCRO STRAPS ARE LOVELY!!

product_metadata.title: Arm Rest Cup Holder - Compatible with Many Tumblers (20/30 Ounce) and Most Other Containers with Tapered (Angled) Sides - for Wheelchairs, Scooters, Office Chairs, Stadium Seats
features: The opening is 3 inches across and is compatible with most containers with angled/tapered walls, including tumblers that are 20-30 ounces such as YETI, RTIC, Mossy Oak, and Ozark Trail.
The mounting portion of the ARCH is 3 inches wide and 5.5 inches long.
Comes with two (2) hook-and-loop straps that are used to attach the cup holder to your arm rest.
Sturdy, thick plastic that feels very durable and will help keep your drink in place.
